# Creator Instructions

**Before you start working on your brief make sure to: File \> Make a Copy**
**Please do NOT edit this doc as it's just a template**

1. Shoot vertically (9x16 or Reels dimension)
2. Record at 1080p or higher (1080x1920). **Disable HDR**
3. Use the back camera of your phone for sharper quality (even for talking heads if possible)
4. Always film in a well-lit space:
   * Natural light is best, but bright artificial light is fine as long as it's not overexposed.
   * Avoid dark or poorly lit footage
   * Avoid direct harsh light hitting the lens (or filming too close to the light source)
   * For reference, try to keep the lighting as close to these examples as possible: [sample 1](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DNJIypysazC/), [sample 2](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DLOEoUDOliZ/) (unless otherwise stated in the shot instructions)
5. Add an extra 1–2 seconds to the start and end of each clip (we'll trim during editing)
6. Do not add music, captions, filters, or color grading
7. Turn off fans, ACs, or other loud devices before filming
8. For shots that require expressions, keep it natural - no exaggerated "TV commercial-style" acting. Aim for realistic expressions/reactions

### **For talking head or script reads:**

1. Film in a space that feels natural to you (your home, office, or any everyday setting). Avoid studio setups, or anything that looks overproduced
2. Hold the phone steady (tripod, phone stand, or propped securely at eye level).
3. Unless otherwise instructed, keep your head centered in the frame - not too high or low ([sample 1](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DNJIypysazC/), [sample 2](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/aiKDwiSn0jQ), [sample 3](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/WqtNAtBRkOE), [sample 4](https://www.instagram.com/reel/C6ep3pnBNcO/))
4. The read should **NOT** sound like an ad. Reword some lines if you need to so they sound natural in your voice, just keep the main point
5. *Lines in italics* are just notes/instructions, not part of the actual script

**When saving assets:**

1. Upload all raw files to this folder (do not downscale quality): [CLICK HERE](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PX5wMxMl6g5lCPvKbd1EOIxcURoxjoyq?usp=sharing)
2. Name each file according to its B-roll number and title. Example: **B-Roll 1 - Natural tag**
   * If the B-Roll requires multiple clips, number them: *B-Roll 1 - Natural tag (1)*, *B-Roll 1 - Natural tag (2)*, and so on **OR** put them inside a folder named after the B-Roll title
   * For the talking head/script read, label the file as Talking Head. If there are multiple clips, number them: Talking Head 1, Talking Head 2, etc.

*See next section for further instructions*

### **For this specific shoot, you'll need:**

*A generic "store" body wash bottle with a **"natural"** claim on the front. If you can't find one, use any plain bottle and stick a **"NATURAL" tag/label** on the front (hang tag or sticker, big enough to read on camera)*

*The same bottle needs a back label where the word **"Fragrance"** is visible in the ingredient list (real store bottle, or a printed label stuck on the back)*

*Local Revival body wash, with the **ingredient list** readable on the back label (or a printed ingredient card held next to the bottle)*

**Notes:**

*Talking head, founder facing the camera the whole time. Fast, direct, informative, not "ad-like". Hold the bottles close enough to the lens so the "natural" tag, "Fragrance" and the Local Revival ingredient list are readable on a phone screen. Total runtime: ~45 seconds. Keep the pace steady and do not rush the ingredient list: it is the proof of the video.*

---

**Script (45s):**

| Script Section | Lines | Instructions |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **PROBLEM** (0–3s) | Your body wash says "natural." It means nothing. | *Founder centered, facing camera, holding the store bottle (or bottle with the "natural" tag) at chest height. On "natural", bring the bottle toward the lens or point at the tag, then look back at camera on "It means nothing."* |
| **AGITATION** (3–9s) | No legal definition. "Fragrance" hides the ingredient list. No one approves it before it's on the shelf. | *Same take, no cut. Turn the bottle to show the back label. Finger on the word "Fragrance" in the ingredient list as you say it, then look back at camera for the last line.* |
| **SOLUTION 1** (9–13s) | Tallow. Honey. Ingredients you know how to pronounce. | *Put the store bottle down or to the side and pick up the Local Revival bottle. Look at camera.* |
| **SOLUTION 2** (13–20s) | Cold-pressed olive oil to help lock in moisture. Grass-fed tallow from Wyoming cows. Jojoba oil. Raw honey for nourishment. | *Turn the Local Revival bottle to the back label and hold it close to the lens. Finger moves down the ingredient list, touching each ingredient as you say it. Glance at camera between ingredients.* |
| **SOLUTION 3** (20–28s) | Aloe vera, castor oil, shea butter for moisture, coconut oil and essential oils for the scent, absolutely nothing synthetic. | *Keep the finger on the list. On "absolutely nothing synthetic", look at camera and tap the end of the list.* |
| **SOLUTION 4** (28–31s) | Yep, that's it, only the good stuff. | *Lower the bottle slightly, small nod, relaxed tone.* |
| **SOLUTION 5** (31–40s) | Everything's organic, they're all real ingredients and we're proud to say nearly every single one of them are sourced from local US farms. | *Talking straight to camera, bottle held at chest height with the front label facing the lens. Sincere tone, not salesy.* |
| **CTA** (40–45s) | Choose between ten scents, get 15% OFF today. Shop Now. | *Hold the Local Revival bottle next to your face, facing camera. Smile slightly, natural tone, point down (link/button) on "Shop Now".* |

---

**Local Revival ingredient list (for the label close-up):**

*Confirm against the final label before filming. Order and wording must match the bottle.*

* Cold-pressed olive oil
* Grass-fed tallow (Wyoming)
* Jojoba oil
* Raw honey
* Aloe vera
* Castor oil
* Shea butter
* Coconut oil
* Essential oils (scent)
